Young Pacers Challenge Senior Indian Batters in Net Practice Ahead of ODI Series

Preparations Underway for Upcoming ODIs

As India's T20I series against New Zealand draws to a close, the focus for the national team is shifting toward the upcoming 50-over ODI fixtures. Senior players, including Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, participated in an intensive training session on Sunday to prepare for the format transition.

Standout Performances from Young Fast Bowlers

According to reports published by RevSportz, a contingent of young Indian fast bowlers utilized the training session to test the senior batting lineup. The group included:

  • Gurnoor Brar: Leveraged his height to generate extra bounce, targeting the batters' bodies.
  • Anshul Kamboj: Maintained a disciplined line and length throughout the workout.
  • Auqib Nabi: Delivered the most notable performance, recently having been drafted into the ODI squad following an injury to Prasidh Krishna.

Detailed Account of the Net Sessions

Reports indicate that Nabi created significant challenges during his spell against Kohli. The young pacer reportedly moved the ball in both directions, repeatedly beating the outside edge of Kohli's bat and occasionally striking his pads and thigh pads with sharp inward movement.

While Kohli displayed his trademark timing on several strokes during the session, the demanding nature of Nabi's bowling reportedly caused visible frustration for the senior batter at times. Observers noted, however, that Kohli quickly moved past the challenging exchanges and was later seen sharing lighthearted moments with Rohit Sharma on the sidelines.

Meanwhile, Rohit Sharma took a more cautious approach in the nets, prioritizing defensive solidity and rhythm over aggressive strokeplay. Other players, including KL Rahul and Ruturaj Gaikwad, also spent time facing the pace attack.

Practical Implications and Verification

The training session offered India's top-order batters essential practice against seam movement and bounce ahead of the opening ODI fixture.
